CameraEnclosure.title: Machine Vision Camera Enclosure with Cooling Jacket (CEWC)
CameraEnclosure.description: The CEWC camera enclosure is designed to accommodate a wide range of machine vision cameras from various manufacturers. The standard enclosure supports 29×29mm, 30×40mm, and 60×60mm cameras from leading brands such as Baumer, Basler, Hikrobot, Allied Vision, FLIR, IDS, and Daheng Imaging. Compatible models include the Ace Classic, Ace U, Blackfly USB3 and GigE, etc. Engineered specifically for high-temperature applications, CEWC series is ideal for industrial environments with ambient temperatures of up to 120°C. For larger cameras, an XL housing option is available. To ensure proper installation and stability, mounting brackets and detailed mounting instructions will be provided. For customized mounting solutions, please contact us directly. The enclosure includes a specially designed air curtain that helps keep the lens cover clean by removing dirt. In intermittent use, it is effective at clearing dry dust and impurities. For continuous operation, it also provides protection against moist dust, oily smoke, and other contaminants.

AdjustableExtensionTube.title: Adjustable Length Extension Tube
AdjustableExtensionTube.description: C-Mount Extension Tubes are precision-engineered components designed to introduce adjustable spacing within an optical system while preventing external light infiltration and contamination from dust or debris. Unlike fixed-length extension tubes, these tubes feature a variable-length design, allowing users to fine-tune the extension distance as needed for optimal system performance. Manufactured with industry-standard C-Mount threading, these extension tubes ensure seamless compatibility with a wide range of optical assemblies, imaging systems, and machine vision applications. Constructed from black anodized aluminum, they offer high durability, high corrosion resistance, and effective suppression of internal reflections. The interior features a threaded surface to further reduce stray light, enhancing image contrast and overall system efficiency. The adjustable nature of these extension tubes eliminates the need for multiple fixed-length tubes, providing greater flexibility in achieving precise optical spacing. Their design accounts for the male threaded portion, ensuring secure and stable mechanical engagement while maintaining proper optical alignment. Whether used in microscopy, machine vision, or custom optical setups, these extension tubes offer a versatile solution for fine-tuning imaging parameters with precision.

features.maleFemaleThreads: Feature male/female threads at opposite ends
features.variousLengths: Available in various lengths for custom extension requirements

FixedExtensionTube.title: Fixed Length Extension Tube
FixedExtensionTube.description: C-Mount Extension Tubes serve as precision-engineered components designed to introduce additional spacing within an optical system while simultaneously preventing external light infiltration and contamination from dust or debris. These extension tubes are manufactured with industry-standard C-Mount threading, ensuring seamless compatibility with a broad spectrum of optical assemblies, imaging systems, and machine vision applications. Constructed from black anodized aluminum, these tubes exhibit high durability and corrosion resistance while effectively minimizing internal reflections. The interior surface of each extension tube features a threaded design, further aiding in the suppression of stray light, thereby enhancing image contrast and overall system performance. Extension Tubes are available in various predefined lengths, which can be modularly combined to achieve the precise extension distance required for a given optical setup. It is important to note that the physical length of the tube exceeds its effective extension length due to the inclusion of the male threaded portion, which contributes to the overall mechanical engagement within the system. This design consideration ensures secure and stable integration while maintaining optimal optical alignment.

description.intro: Machine vision bar lights are elongated, high-output LED lighting modules designed to provide consistent and directional illumination across wide inspection areas. They are well-suited for tasks such as examining large-scale parts or monitoring items moving at high speed on conveyor lines. Depending on their mounting orientation, these lights can function in bright-field mode—positioned perpendicularly to the object surface to improve the visibility of flat, printed, or reflective features—or in dark-field mode, where they are angled shallowly to highlight fine surface structures, edges, and imperfections like scratches, burrs, or dents. Their performance is supported by attributes such as uniform light distribution, adjustable intensity control, and the option to select from multiple spectral outputs (white, red, blue, green, infrared, or ultraviolet). This versatility allows bar lights to be tuned to the optical characteristics of different materials and inspection objectives, while ensuring stable illumination necessary for reliable image processing and advanced vision analysis.

Machine vision ring lights are circular LED-based illumination units engineered to deliver consistent, shadow-minimized lighting aligned with a camera’s optical axis. Their annular design ensures balanced light distribution across the inspection area, which improves contrast and reduces shading when imaging components with uneven geometries or reflective finishes. By varying the mounting angle and distance, ring lights can be applied in bright-field mode to enhance printed or flat surfaces, or in diffuse mode to suppress glare from polished metals, plastics, or glass.These illuminators are produced in multiple wavelengths—including visible, infrared, and ultraviolet—so that lighting can be tuned to material characteristics and inspection goals. Advanced variants offer adjustable intensity, strobe operation, and optional polarizers for improved control of reflections. Their coaxial placement with the lens makes them highly effective in precision tasks such as defect detection, code recognition, assembly verification, and dimensional inspection, where uniform, stable lighting is essential.

The Machine Vision Dome Light provides smooth, uniform illumination ideal for precision inspection. Its curved dome design spreads light evenly from all angles, reducing reflections and eliminating shadows on shiny, contoured, or textured surfaces. High-output LEDs ensure stable brightness and are available in multiple wavelengths, including white, red, blue, and infrared to suit diverse imaging needs. The durable aluminum body enhances heat dissipation, supporting long operating life and consistent performance in continuous industrial use. Optional dimming, strobe control, and compatibility with machine vision systems make this dome light suitable for electronics, automotive, medical, and high-accuracy optical inspections.

flat-diffused-light-with-center-hole.title: Flat Diffused Light With Center Hole

description.intro: Machine vision diffused flat lights with a central hole are specialized illumination devices designed for coaxial, on-axis bright field lighting. By integrating a highly-diffusive panel with a central camera aperture, it provides uniform, low-glare illumination that travels along the same optical path as the camera's lens. This unique configuration effectively minimizes shadows and specular reflections on highly reflective, flat surfaces, while simultaneously ensuring that any remaining reflections are directed back into the camera. This makes them exceptionally effective for revealing subtle surface defects like scratches or micro-cracks that would be difficult to detect with other lighting techniques.

Machine vision diffused flat lights are illumination devices that provide a highly uniform, shadow-less light source by scattering light from multiple angles. This bright field illumination technique is especially effective for inspecting objects with shiny, curved, or irregular surfaces. The light's diffusion minimizes harsh reflections and glare, allowing for the clear detection of surface defects, features, and textures that would be obscured by conventional lighting.

A machine vision indirect flat light is a specialized illumination device that provides a highly uniform, diffused, and low-glare light source. Unlike a direct light, this system uses internal LEDs to illuminate a highly reflective, internal surface. The light is then scattered and re-emitted from this surface, which acts as a large, homogeneous light source, mimicking the soft, shadow-less illumination of an overcast sky. This design is highly effective at eliminating the hotspots and harsh directional shadows common with conventional lighting. Many models include a central aperture for the camera lens, enabling a coaxial lighting setup. This alignment allows the camera to capture images on-axis, which is crucial for minimizing specular reflections and glare on highly polished or curved surfaces. The result is a consistent, shadow-less image that reveals subtle surface details, such as scratches or dents, without being overwhelmed by reflective artifacts. The compact, flat form factor also makes it a space-saving alternative to traditional dome lights.
Back Lights produce strong background illumination to create silhouettes of the object, useful for shape and outline inspection.

Machine vision spot lights are high-intensity, point-source LED illumination devices that project a focused beam of light onto a specific area. By using lenses and collimators, they concentrate light to provide very high illuminance, making them suitable for high-speed imaging or illuminating features on low-reflectivity surfaces. Their directional nature allows them to be used for both bright field and dark field applications to highlight surface anomalies like scratches or engraved markings. Compact and powerful, they are ideal for targeted illumination over varying working distances and for use in tight spaces.
Tunnel Lights provide bright, uniform lighting inside conveyor tunnels for capturing defect-free product images in production lines.

1.title: Vial Adaptor Inspection
1.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System for Vial Adaptor Inspection
1.description:
Project Overview:
An AI-based visual inspection system was required for vial adaptors during production to ensure quality control and defect detection.

System Requirements:
Detect and classify common defects such as damaged fingers, improper slots, and broken or missing spikes.
Operate at a speed of 300 PPM (parts per minute).
Provide real-time feedback to the production line with high accuracy.

Key Challenges:
Variability in defect types.
High-speed inspection requirements (300 PPM).
Defining and setting precise tolerance limits.

CVIT AI Solution:
Developed a deep learning-based vision model trained on thousands of images of acceptable and defective vial adaptors.
Designed high-level computations to detect defects as small as 200 microns.
Integrated a high-speed camera and processing unit capable of handling 300 PPM inspection speed.
Implemented edge-based preprocessing to ensure robust detection under varying lighting conditions.
Achieved over 99.99% accuracy at production speed with real-time alerts for defective units.

2.title: Vial Adaptor Tray OCR-OCV
2.studyHeader: AI-Based OCR-OCV System for Vial Adaptor Trays
2.description:
Project Overview:
An AI-driven OCR-OCV system was needed for vial adaptor trays to ensure the accuracy and compliance of printed information.

System Requirements:
Verify printed text such as batch codes, expiration dates, and other critical details.
Ensure text is legible, correctly placed, and matches expected values.

Key Challenges:
Variability in print quality – variations in ink spread, fading, or smudging.
Font and size variability – ensuring accuracy across multiple text formats.
High-speed verification – maintaining accuracy while matching production line speed.
Alignment and placement issues – printed text may be slightly offset or misaligned on the tray.

CVIT AI Solution:
Implemented a flexible deep learning-based OCR engine capable of recognizing multiple fonts, sizes, and orientations.
Applied synthetic data augmentation to handle poor print conditions such as fading, smudging, or low contrast.
Enabled real-time comparison with expected templates via OCV to ensure data integrity.
Integrated an alert system for illegible or non-matching prints.
Achieved over 99.99% OCR accuracy in real-world production environments at line speed.

3.title: Gap Measurement
3.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System for Gap Measurement Between Vial and Vial Adaptor Tray
3.description:
Project Overview:
An AI-based vision system was developed to automate precise measurement of gaps between vials and adaptors in trays.

System Requirements:
Ensure gap tolerances are consistently maintained across all units.
Provide precise real-time feedback to support high-speed production quality control.

Key Challenges:
Transparent parts – difficulty in detecting vial and adaptor edges due to transparency.
Lighting conditions – variations in lighting affecting consistent image capture.
Gap measurement accuracy – ensuring micron-level precision to maintain strict tolerances.

CVIT AI Solution:
Designed a custom machine vision model using edge detection and neural network interpretation.
Used high-resolution line scan cameras to achieve micron-level precision.
Applied AI to correct perspective distortion using 3D pose estimation.
Integrated measurement feedback into PLC for automatic rejection of defective assemblies.
System achieved ±0.05 mm measurement repeatability.

4.title: Stamped Number Detection
4.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System for Stamped Number Detection
4.description:
Project Overview:
An AI-based machine vision system was required to ensure reliable detection of stamped numbers on engine cylinder heads for quality and traceability.

System Requirements:
Detect and verify stamped numbers despite errors in stamping machine operations.
Handle variations in character shapes, depths, and alignments caused by mechanical inconsistencies.
Provide real-time feedback to maintain production quality and traceability.

Key Challenges:
Font variations – different character styles, sizes, and stamping depths making consistent detection difficult.
Integration with existing server – ensuring seamless connectivity and data exchange with the client's current IT/production infrastructure.
Lack of raw data – limited availability of labeled samples to build and train a robust deep learning model.

CVIT AI Solution:
Developed seamless integration using Python libraries, enabling connectivity with the client's existing server infrastructure.
Implemented high-level OCR software designed for industrial applications, capable of handling variations in stamped fonts and depths.
Optimized the model to achieve 100% accuracy on all alphanumeric characters using only 25% of the main data for training.

5.title: Tire Tracing and Tracking
5.studyHeader: AI-Based Tire Tracing and Tracking Solution
5.description:
Project Overview:
An AI-based tire tracing and tracking system was developed to ensure compliance in assembly and labeling.

System Requirements:
Provide 100% traceability to verify each tire was assembled per vehicle configuration.
Ensure barcode-based labeling of tires post-successful inspection for identification and tracking.
Maintain real-time data logging of inspection results for audit and reporting.
Support integration with the client's existing production and IT systems.
Deliver high accuracy and speed to match production line throughput.

Key Challenges:
Detecting black characters on black tires – ensuring reliable character and barcode recognition despite low contrast between print and surface.
Maintaining production time – achieving precise inspection and traceability without slowing assembly line throughput.

CVIT AI Solution:
Implemented a hybrid system: AI-based part recognition + barcode/QR detection.
Integrated with MES system to log timestamps, location, and status for each component.
Used multiple-angle cameras to ensure 360° visibility.
Achieved 99% tracking coverage with automatic alerts for missing or illegible tags.

6.title: Door Sealant Presence Detection
6.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System for Door Sealant Presence Detection
6.description:
Project Overview:
An AI-based machine vision system was required to ensure accurate detection of door sealant presence during production.

System Requirements:
Detect the presence or absence of sealant strips with high accuracy.
Handle part variations due to different door models and designs.
Verify the correct number of sealant strips to ensure compliance with assembly standards.
Provide real-time inspection feedback to support production quality control.

Key Challenges:
Low contrast detection – sealant color often similar to the door frame, making differentiation difficult.
Application variability – robot-applied sealant may result in missing or misplaced areas.
Real-time inspection – inspection must be completed immediately before the next production stage to avoid rework or defects passing downstream.

CVIT AI Solution:
System first detects door part type to determine required sealant quantity and strip positions.
Implemented deep learning vision algorithms capable of distinguishing sealant even when color closely matches the door frame.
Integrated profile and edge-based inspection to identify missing or misplaced sealant areas.
Designed for real-time inspection, ensuring defects are flagged before the next production stage.
Integrated with pneumatic sensor to secure parts until verified compliant, preventing defective parts from advancing.
Achieved high accuracy at line speed, reducing rework and ensuring assembly compliance.

7.title: Window Glass Open/Close Detection
7.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System for Window Glass Open/Close Detection
7.description:
Project Overview:
An AI-based visual inspection system was developed to ensure window glasses are closed before the spraying process.

System Requirements:
Inspect window glasses from left, right, and top sides to verify proper closure.
Detect any incompletely closed glasses with high accuracy.
Automatically stop the conveyor line upon detecting defective glass to prevent it from entering the spraying stage.
Operate in real-time without impacting production throughput.

Key Challenges:
Transparent glass detection – ensuring reliable closure detection despite transparency and reflections.
Custom lighting design – need for lighting setup to enhance visibility of glass edges and closure gaps.
Production accuracy compliance – achieving required inspection accuracy while maintaining production line speed.

CVIT AI Solution:
Precisely measures glass gaps to detect incomplete closures.
Identifies defective glasses in real-time with high accuracy.
Integrated with production line to automatically stop operations upon defect detection, preventing defective products from advancing.
Operates seamlessly without impacting production throughput.

8.title: Tub TYVEK Inspection
8.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System for Tub TYVEK Inspection
8.description:
Project Overview:
An AI-based machine vision system was developed to inspect the placement of Inner and Outer TYVEK sheets in tubs during production. The system checks that each TYVEK sheet is correctly placed, fully seated, and meets client acceptance standards before the tub moves to the next stage.

System Requirements:
Inspect whether the Inner TYVEK is properly centered and fully placed within the defined square area inside the tub.
Inspect whether the Outer TYVEK fully covers the outer tub surface with no visible gap on any side.
Detect placement defects such as misalignment, folds, wrinkles, or lifted edges.
Provide real-time OK/NOK output for immediate feedback on the production line.

Key Challenges:
Subtle defect detection – even a gap as small as 1 mm on the outer tub must be reliably detected and flagged as NOK.
Multiple defect types – the system must correctly identify misalignment, folded corners, wrinkles, and lifted edges across both Inner and Outer TYVEK.
Real-time inspection – the check must be completed within the production cycle time without slowing the line.

CVIT AI Solution:
The AI vision system inspects the Inner TYVEK to confirm it is correctly centered and fully positioned within the defined square scope area, with all four sides within the allowed boundary.
The system inspects the Outer TYVEK to confirm it fully covers the tub surface from edge to edge, flagging any visible tub area as NOK.
Defects such as shifted placement, folded corners, wrinkles, and lifted edges are detected and reported in real time.
Automated OK/NOK output is provided instantly, allowing the production line to respond to any defective placement without delay.

9.title: Pick to Right Part – Hand Brake Cable Assembly
9.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System – Pick to Right Part Hand Brake Cable
9.description:
Project Overview:
At the hand brake cable assembly station, 4 types of cable are available. During assembly the operator fits the wrong variant of hand brake cable to the axle. The customer requires an AI-based vision system to validate whether the correct cable is picked by the operator according to the variant of axle, and to stop the conveyor immediately in case of an N-OK condition.

Project Requirements:
Validate whether the operator picks the correct cable variant according to the axle variant signal received from the PLC.
Monitor all 4 cable bins at the hand brake cable assembly station.
Stop the conveyor immediately when an N-OK pick condition is detected.
Integrate with the existing PLC control system via Modbus protocol.

Key Challenges:
The size, colour and dimension are the same for all 4 cable variants, making it extremely critical to classify each variant correctly.
The system must detect hand gestures and identify the bin accessed by the operator within the production cycle time.
The variant number must be received from the PLC before each pick to determine the correct expected bin.

CVIT Solution:
Integration with existing PLC: The machine vision system is integrated via Modbus protocol to the existing control system. Before assembly, the PLC system sends the variant number to the vision system.
Classification Model: The AI-based software captures the hand gestures and bin type. If the operator picks a cable from any bin, the system is capable of detection.
Unmatched Accuracy: The AI model delivers 100% accuracy in detection of the cable from the bin.

10.title: AI-Based Machine Vision System – VIN Plate Detection
10.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System – VIN Plate Detection
10.description:
Project Overview:
The customer requires a solution that will detect the VIN plate on the vehicle and recognise the Vehicle Identification Number. The detected number needs to be verified with the master VIN to confirm correct vehicle identity at the inspection station.

Project Requirements:
Detect and locate the VIN plate on the vehicle.
Recognise the Vehicle Identification Number from the detected plate.
Verify the detected number against the master VIN record.
Detect each and every alphanumeric character and match with the standard VIN format.

Key Challenges:
The customer required to detect each and every alphanumeric character and match with the standard VIN format.
Every character must be correctly identified to avoid mismatch with the master VIN.
The system must operate at real-time production speed without causing any line delay.

CVIT Solution:
Integration: CVIT has integrated the vision software to the existing MES PLC.
Speed: The vision system is developed to work in real time with production speed.
Unmatched Accuracy: The AI model delivers 99.9% accuracy in detection of the VIN Plate.

11.title: Ladle Hook Inspection
11.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System for Ladle Hook Safety Inspection
11.description:
Project Overview:
An AI-based machine vision safety system was developed for steel plant operations to verify whether the ladle is properly fitted into the crane hook before lifting molten material. The system helps crane operators avoid accidents caused by incorrect ladle-to-hook connection, particularly in conditions where visibility is limited.

System Requirements:
Capture images at the ladle loading point to check the connection between the ladle and the crane hook.
Determine whether the hook connection is correct and safe before the lift begins.
Provide an immediate visual signal via a tower lamp to guide the crane operator.
Operate reliably in the harsh conditions of a steel plant including high heat, dust, and low lighting.

Key Challenges:
Harsh environment – steel plant conditions involve high heat, dust, and steam that can affect camera view and image clarity.
Low visibility – crane operators often work in areas where they cannot clearly see the hook connection, making manual checks unreliable.
Short inspection window – the check must be completed quickly before the lift begins, leaving very little time to confirm the connection.

CVIT AI Solution:
Machine vision cameras with protective cooling and cleaning enclosures are installed at the ladle loading point to capture clear images even in harsh steel plant conditions.
The AI system checks each image to confirm whether the ladle is correctly and securely connected to the crane hook.
The result is immediately shown on a tower lamp – Green Light means the ladle is correctly hooked and the lift can proceed, Red Light means the connection is not correct and the operator must fix it before lifting.
The system also provides real-time display, inspection history, and automatic report generation for safety records.
Automated monitoring removes the need for manual visual checks, improving safety and preventing ladle-dropping accidents.

12.title: AI-Based Machine Vision System – 360° Cylinder Head Inspection
12.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System for 360° Cylinder Head Inspection
12.description:
Project Overview:
The customer requires a complete 360° inspection of cylinder heads while the engine remains stationary on the production line. Multiple machine vision cameras are fixed at strategic positions around the stationary cylinder head, capturing images from multiple angles simultaneously to detect surface defects and ensure quality at production speed.

Project Requirements:
360° inspection of cylinder heads while the engine remains stationary.
Integration of multiple machine vision cameras fixed at multiple positions for full-coverage imaging.
Cycle time aligned with production rate.
Detection of defects such as cracks, oil marks, black marks, and damages.

Key Challenges:
Complex geometry of cylinder heads (holes, grooves, internal features) makes complete surface coverage and uniform lighting difficult.
All critical surfaces must be inspected in a single automated pass without any blind spots.
The full 360° inspection must complete within the production takt time without causing line stoppages.

CVIT Solution:
Multiple machine vision cameras fixed at optimized positions around the stationary cylinder head.
Simultaneous multi-angle image acquisition ensures complete 360° coverage.
Trigger-based image capture synchronized with production line signals.
Pre-programmed inspection zones with dynamic adjustments.
ROI-based inspection for critical zones.
Dashboard for visualization and reporting.

13.title: Bag Seal Wrinkle Inspection
13.studyHeader: AI-Based Machine Vision System for Bag Seal Wrinkle Inspection
13.description:
Project Overview:
An AI-based machine vision system was developed to inspect sterile packaging bag seals during production. The system detects wrinkles, folds, and sealing defects in real time to ensure proper sealing quality before the bag moves to the next production stage.

System Requirements:
Inspect single and double bag sealing areas.
Detect wrinkles, folds, and seal deformation.
Provide real-time OK/NOK inspection results.
Store inspection images and defect history.
Integrate with PLC systems for rejection handling.

Key Challenges:
Transparent bags create reflection and lighting variation.
Small wrinkles are difficult to detect manually.
Inspection must work accurately at high production speed.
Variations in bag position affect inspection consistency.

CVIT AI Solution:
AI vision system detects wrinkles and sealing defects with high accuracy.
Multiple machine vision cameras inspect different sealing zones.
Real-time AI inspection provides instant OK/NOK results.
Defect images are automatically saved for traceability.
Integrated PLC communication enables alarm, rejection, and conveyor stop functions.

14.title: Android Barcode Scanning & Part Verification
14.studyHeader: AI-Based Android Application for Barcode Scanning & Part Verification
14.description:
Project Overview:
An Android-based barcode scanning system was developed to verify whether all parts assembled on construction equipment match the required vehicle model configuration. The system uses a handheld Android device to scan VIN numbers and part serial numbers in real time during assembly.

System Requirements:
Scan VIN numbers and part serial numbers using a handheld Android device.
Verify assembled parts according to vehicle model configuration.
Detect wrong or missing parts during assembly.
Provide instant OK/NOK validation results.
Maintain assembly traceability and inspection records.
Support loading of vehicle and part master data.

Key Challenges:
Managing multiple VIN and part configuration data.
Real-time validation of scanned parts during assembly.
Avoiding wrong part assembly across different vehicle models.
Ensuring smooth communication between Android device and server database.

CVIT AI Solution:
CVIT developed an Android application for VIN and part barcode scanning.
The system verifies scanned parts with the configured vehicle model in real time.
Web-based GUI allows easy upload of vehicle and part data in XLSX format.
Instant alerts are generated if incorrect parts are assembled.
Inspection data and traceability records are automatically maintained.

step1.title: Requirement Understanding
description: Define project scope and conduct an end-to-end study of the current process at the client's site.
Analyze key project parameters, including environmental and operational constraints.
Discuss automation opportunities to replace or enhance manual processes using AI vision systems.
Evaluate the feasibility and limitations of deploying an AI vision system at the production site.

step2.title: Hardware Design & Installation
description: Design and fabricate custom hardware components, such as camera mounting fixtures.
Protective enclosures for cameras and computers.
AI vision-specific lighting configurations.

step3.title: Software & Network Design
description: Finalize the vision system architecture and process flow.
Design a user-friendly interface for operators and administrators.

step7.title: On-Site Installation

step8.title: Data Collection & AI Model Generation

Train AI models and conduct iterative testing to optimize performance.

Finalize the solution post successful user approval.

Privacy.introText: Thank you for visiting the CVIT Solutions website. Your privacy is important to us.
Privacy.introDescription: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your information when you use our site and related services.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.description: We may collect information in the following ways:

subsection1.title: Information You Voluntarily Provide:
subsection1.description: When you submit forms (contact, inquiry, demo, quotes, etc.), you may provide personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, company name, job title, project requirements.

subsection2.title: Information Automatically Collected:
subsection2.description: When you visit or navigate the site, we automatically collect certain technical/usage data, including but not limited to your IP address, browser type and version, operating system, pages viewed, time spent on pages, referring/exit pages, and click-stream data.

subsection3.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies:
subsection3.description: We may use cookies, web beacons, tracking pixels, and similar technologies to collect information about your site usage, improve functionality, perform analytics, and personalize your experience.

section2.title: 2. Use of Information
section2.description: We use the collected information for various purposes, including:

list.respondToInquiries: Responding to your inquiries or requests (information, quotes, support).
list.provideServices: Providing, maintaining, and improving our services and site.
list.sendUpdates: Sending you updates, newsletters, marketing communications (if you have opted in).
list.analyzeTraffic: Understanding usage patterns, analyzing traffic, and site performance.
list.enhanceSecurity: Enhancing security and preventing/detecting fraud or abuse.
list.fulfillLegalObligations: Fulfilling legal or regulatory obligations, if any.

section3.title: 3. Sharing of Information
section3.description: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information in the following circumstances:

list.serviceProviders: With service providers who assist us with hosting, website analytics, email communications, customer relationship management, security, etc., who act under agreements to protect your data.
list.legalReasons: For legal reasons: If required by law, regulation, legal process, or applicable governmental request.
list.protectRights: To protect the rights, safety, or property of CVIT Solutions, our users, or the public.
list.corporateTransaction: In the case of a corporate transaction (merger, acquisition, asset sale), provided the acquiring party agrees to protect the information in line with this policy.

list.useCookies: We use cookies and similar tools to track site usage and enhance your experience.
list.controlCookies: You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling cookies may affect some features or functionality of the site.
list.cookieTypes: Types of cookies used may include: essential cookies, performance/analytics cookies, functional cookies, and advertising cookies (if applicable).

section5.title: 5. Data Retention
section5.description: We will retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy (e.g., responding to requests, providing services, complying with legal obligations). Thereafter, we will securely delete or anonymize your data.

section6.title: 6. Security
section6.description: We implement reasonable technical, administrative, and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no system is completely secure; data transmission over the internet is inherently risky.

section7.title: 7. International Data Transfers
section7.description: As the site is hosted on the internet and may use service providers in different jurisdictions, your data may be stored or transferred to countries outside your own. We will take steps to ensure such transfers comply with applicable data protection laws.

section8.title: 8. Your Rights
section8.description: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:

access.title: Access
access.description: Request access to your personal information

deletion.title: Deletion
deletion.description: Request deletion of your data under certain conditions

objection.title: Objection
objection.description: Object to the processing of your data for specific purposes

portability.title: Portability
portability.description: Receive your data in a structured, commonly used format

withdrawConsent.title: Withdraw Consent
withdrawConsent.description: Withdraw consent for data processing (where consent is the legal basis)

section8.contact: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

section9.title: 9. Children's Privacy
section9.description: Our site is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we learn we have collected such information, we will take steps to delete it.
